info.title: grate
info.description:
grate - sql for the 20s
    
grate is a no-code, low-fi database migration tool, inspired heavily by RoundhousE. It's written from the ground
up using modern .NET 8/9/10/11.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Install grate's bundled agent skill for Codex and Claude Code.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Copy the bundled use-grate skill into .agents/skills and .claude/skills.

options.name: --local
options.description: Install in the current repository, or current directory outside a repository.

options.name: --global
options.description: Install in the current user's home directory.

options.name: --path
options.description: Explicit project root for --local (instead of repository discovery).

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace existing use-grate directories, including local edits and extra files.

options.name: --connstring
options.description: You now provide an entire connection string. ServerName and Database are obsolete.

options.name: --adminconnstring
options.description: The connection string for connecting to master, if you want to create the database.  Defaults to the same as --connstring.

options.name: --sqlfilesdirectory
options.description: The directory where your SQL scripts are [default: .]

options.name: --outputPath
options.description: Directory for migration artifacts such as copies of executed SQL scripts. To save console logs, redirect stdout and stderr. [default: <path>]

options.name: --folders
options.description:
Folder configuration.
If you wish to override any of the default folder names, supply a semicolon separated list of mappings.
You can also specify a file name that has the same contents as you would supply on the command line,
if you find it cumbersome to write all the folders on the command line.
Explicit folder paths and folders in a fully custom configuration must exist.
Standard folders with no explicit path override are optional.
